items.title: 8.16.1 Haber process se ammonia ka banna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.16.1, printed pages 183-184.

blocks.text: Industry ki bunyadi zaroorat yeh hai ke product ki zyada se zyada yield mile. Ammonia ke industrial banane mein zyada yield ke liye hum equilibrium ka concept istemal kar sakte hain.
Nitrogen aur hydrogen se ammonia banna reversible process hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne is equation ke saath ΔH = −46.11 kJ mol⁻¹ likha hai. −46.11 kJ ek mole NH₃ banne ki enthalpy hai; equation mein 2NH₃ bante hain, is liye ΔH = 2 × (−46.11) = −92.2 kJ (Quick Check 8.6 ki table bhi −92 kJ mol⁻¹ deti hai). Sign manfi hi hai: reaction exothermic hai aur baqi nateeje wahi hain.
Ammonia ki zyada se zyada yield in tareeqon se milti hai:

items: Waqtan fawaqtan ammonia ko bartan se nikal kar us ki concentration kam karein. Le-Chatelier ke principle ke mutabiq equilibrium forward shift hoga.
Reactants ke 4 moles mil kar products ke 2 moles banate hain, yani reaction mein volume kam hota hai. Zyada pressure equilibrium ko right shift kar ke aur ammonia deta hai.
Yeh exothermic reaction hai. Temperature kam karne se Le-Chatelier ke principle ke mutabiq reaction forward shift hoti hai.

blocks.text: Neeche Table 8.1 aur Fig 8.4 dekh kar saaf hai ke pressure aur temperature ka ammonia ki yield par bohat gehra asar hai. Sab se mukammal conversion 473 K (200 °C) aur 1000 atmosphere par 98.3% hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Table 8.2' aur 'Figure 8.3' ka hawala deti hai; murad Table 8.1 aur Fig 8.4 hain jo isi safhe par chhapi hain.

blocks.caption: Table (8.1): Effect of Temperature on Kc for Ammonia Synthesis.

blocks.alt: NH3 ki yield (%) 0 se 100 tak, darja hararat 200 se 700 °C ke muqable. Paanch girte curves: 1000 atm, 600 atm, 300 atm, 100 atm aur 10 atm. 200 °C par yield taqreeban 98, 95, 90, 81 aur 50 feesad; darja hararat barhne par sab girti hain. Taqreeban 400 °C aur 43 feesad par 100 atm aur 300 atm curves ke darmiyan ek chhota daira hai jis se teer 'Industrial conditions' ki taraf jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.4: Paanch mukhtalif dabaon par darja hararat (°C) ke muqable ammonia ki feesad yield (kitab ki Figure 8.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har curve ek pressure ka hai: pressure jitna zyada, curve utna oopar, yani yield zyada. Har curve right taraf girta hai kyun ke reaction exothermic hai aur garmi yield kam karti hai. Daira (circle) industrial halaat dikhata hai: 200 se 300 atm aur taqreeban 400 °C, jahan yield kam (taqreeban 40%) magar reaction kaafi tez hai.

200 °C par yield to zyada hai magar reaction bohat sust ho jati hai aur kaam mehnga (uneconomical) parta hai. Is liye temperature darmiyane level, yani 400 °C, tak barhaya jata hai aur rate barhane ke liye catalyst istemal hota hai. Catalyst ke baghair wahi rate lene ke liye kahin zyada temperature chahiye, jo yield kam kar deta hai.
Ammonia ki behtareen yield ke halaat
Ammonia ki zyada se zyada yield ke liye munasib halaat yeh hain:

items: Catalyst: MgO, Al₂O₃ aur SiO₂ ke pighle (fused) mixture mein lohe (iron) ke crystals ke tukre
N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃ exothermic hai aur gas moles 4 se 2 hote hain: yield zyada pressure, ammonia nikalne aur kam temperature se barhti hai (200 °C aur 1000 atm par 98.3%).
Kam temperature bohat sust hai, is liye 200-300 atm, taqreeban 673 K aur iron catalyst.
Kc 200 K par 7.15 × 10¹⁵ se 800 K par 3.96 × 10⁻² tak girta hai.
